description: It reads whether the people who registered were told about a new date: whether the date was changed and the new invitation is still pending, how many registered people would receive it, and the banner text and button that the page shows. Take it when a host asks whether everyone knows about the moved date. "Did all of them get the new date?" It needs the webinar id. It only reads and changes nothing, and it says what is still waiting before any mail goes out. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: new date, moved webinar, pending invitation, banner

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.
